name: Meiko Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Meiko Electronics Co., Ltd. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of printed circuit boards (PCBs) and other electronic related products in Japan, China, Vietnam, the rest of Asia, the United States, Europe, and internationally. Its products portfolio includes double-sided/multi-layer, HDI, flexible, rigid-flex, high electric current, embedded devices, layer, copper inlay, millimetre wave radar, heavy copper, and through hole PCBs, as well as liquidloop and metal base heat dissipation PCBs; PCB testers, solder stencils, and imaging devices and systems; and mounting jig, metal mask, and component mounting.
